messages:
Ella R: Hi! Quick onboarding question — where should I put my team ramp notes and working docs in Notion so the engineering team can edit them? I copied the 'Team Ramp Template' into my workspace but I don't see how to give the eng team edit access.
Maya (DevEx): Welcome Ella :wave: For team collaborative docs we usually put pages under the Team space (Docs › eng › <team-name>). If you want the whole engineering team to edit, move the page into your team's space and set the page permissions to 'Can edit' for the eng group.
Maya (DevEx): Steps: 1) Click ••• on the page -> Move to -> choose 'eng / <your-team>'. 2) Open Share -> Invite -> type "eng@redwood.com" -> set role to 'Can edit'. 3) If you need the template copied first: File -> Duplicate, then move the duplicate.
Samir: FYI eng group is [eng@redwood.com] — sometimes auto-suggest doesn't show, type full group email. Also watch out: if the page is in your private space you need to transfer ownership to the team space or members outside your private space won't see it.
Ella R: Thanks — I tried moving but Notion gave me a permission error: "You don't have permission to move this page". I think the original template is in another team's space.
Jess: If the template is owned by another workspace, ping the owner or ask a Docs admin to move it. I can grant you a one-off 'Can duplicate & move' right if you want — @Ella R want me to do that?
Ella R: Yes please, that would be great. My page id is 3f2b1c9a (the last part of the URL).
Maya (DevEx): I've created a Docs ticket for the transfer so we don't lose metadata. Ticket #DOC-823. devex-bot should post the link below.
devex-bot: Ticket created: DOC-823 — "Transfer: Ella R ramp notes -> eng space". Assignee: Docs Ops. Link: https://tickets.redwood.com/DOC-823
Jess: Done — granted temporary duplication/move rights to Ella. You should be able to duplicate and move now. After you move it, set the share to eng@redwood.com as Can edit.
Ella R: I moved it and set the group permission. Can everyone edit now?
Samir: I can see and edit it — looks good. Thanks for tidying up.
Ella R: Amazing, thanks everyone! Also: where do we keep canonical templates so others can copy them?
Maya (DevEx): Canonical templates live in Docs › Templates › Team templates. If you think something should be added there, open a PR on the templates tracker (link in the Templates page) or ping #devex with the page link.
Ella R: Will do. Appreciate the quick help :pray:
